I don't know yet. Corvane hasn't set its 2027 per-payout fee, and the renewal talks are still going on.

- **Current price:** $0.08 per ACH item [1]. The October invoice matches this: $14,212.40 for 177,655 ACH items [5]. The current agreement runs until March 31, 2027 [1].
- **Our assumption:** The Q1 2027 pricing memo assumes the fee stays at $0.08 in 2027. If it goes above $0.10, we're supposed to revisit the bottom pricing tier [1].
- **What's changed since:** On Nov 16, Marcus Oyelaran said our Corvane relationship manager, Paula Brandt, hinted they want to raise the per-item fee after the Nov 10 rejected file. There's "nothing on paper yet," and the renewal call has moved to the week of Nov 23 [6].
- **Effect on customer pricing:** Marcus says the Corvane fee only affects our margin, not customer pricing. The Q1 notices still go out on Nov 24 [6].

Marcus is the one to ask for updates after that call.
